name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)

          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &

          TEST_EXIT=$?

          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          # Verify rpath was set
          otool -l "$BINARY" | grep -A2 LC_RPATH || echo "WARNING: No LC_RPATH found"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          # Verify rpath was set
          otool -l "$BINARY" | grep -A2 LC_RPATH || echo "WARNING: No LC_RPATH found"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          # Verify FUSE is available
          ls -la /dev/fuse || echo "WARNING: /dev/fuse not found"
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

file.content:
name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          # Verify rpath was set
          otool -l "$BINARY" | grep -A2 LC_RPATH || echo "WARNING: No LC_RPATH found"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          # Verify FUSE is available
          ls -la /dev/fuse || echo "WARNING: /dev/fuse not found"
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

content.thinking:
Looking at the macOS log, the rpath fix worked! The binary starts, creates the tray icon, creates the login webview, and reports setup complete. But the mount never appears.

The key logs:
```
CipherBox Desktop starting...
--dev-key provided: headless auth mode enabled
System tray icon created
Dev-key mode: auto-creating login webview
CipherBox Desktop setup complete (tray icon active)
```

Then... nothing. The mount never appears after 90s.

The same issue is happening on Linux. Let me check the Linux logs too.

The pattern is clear: the binary starts, creates a login webview, but the auth flow never completes. 

I'm realizing the webview should load the frontend, the frontend detects the dev-key and calls the Tauri command to complete auth, then the mount starts. But something's breaking in this chain—either the webview isn't loading the frontend, the frontend can't detect the dev-key, or the auth silently fails. I need to figure out whether `cargo build` actually embeds the frontend from `frontendDist` or if it only builds the Rust side.

Looking at this more carefully, I think `cargo build` might not embed the frontend at all—only `tauri build` does that. When you run `cargo build`, Tauri probably expects a dev server running via `devUrl`. But the original CI workflow used the same `cargo build` command and apparently had passing tests at some point, so either the tests never actually worked in CI, or something changed in how Tauri handles this.

Let me dig into the Tauri v2 source to understand what's happening. The `tauri_build::build()` function in build.rs processes the `frontendDist` config and generates code at compile time—for both debug and release builds in v2, it embeds the frontend assets directly into the binary. The `devUrl` only gets used when running `tauri dev` with a special environment variable set.

So if the frontend was built before running cargo, it should have been embedded. Let me check the `frontendDist` configuration more carefully to see what's actually happening.

The path `../dist` is relative to `tauri.conf.json` in `apps/desktop/src-tauri/`, which means it's looking for `apps/desktop/dist/`. Since we ran `pnpm vite build` from `apps/desktop`, the output should be in the right place. The `tauri-codegen` should have embedded those files via `include_str!` macros during compilation.

But maybe the webview is loading the frontend correctly, and the real issue is that the frontend can't communicate with the Tauri backend.

Actually, I'm wondering if the problem is that the frontend was built with `VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` baked in at build time, so it's trying to authenticate using that hardcoded secret. The headless auth flow might be failing because the API isn't available or the authentication isn't working properly. Let me trace through how the frontend actually uses that environment variable and what the auth flow looks like in main.rs.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# run-all.sh -- Orchestrate the full desktop E2E test suite.
#
# Runs wait-for-mount, FUSE file I/O tests, and API round-trip tests.
# Reports an aggregate pass/fail summary and exits with the total failure count.
#
# Environment:
#   MOUNT_POINT   Path to FUSE mount (default: $HOME/CipherBox)
#   API_URL       Backend API URL (default: http://localhost:3000)
#   TEST_SECRET   test-login shared secret (default: e2e-test-secret-ci-only)

MOUNT_POINT="${MOUNT_POINT:-$HOME/CipherBox}"
API_URL="${API_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"
TEST_SECRET="${TEST_SECRET:-e2e-test-secret-ci-only}"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

TOTAL_PASS=0
TOTAL_FAIL=0

echo "============================================"
echo "  CipherBox Desktop E2E Test Suite"
echo "============================================"
echo ""
echo "Mount point: $MOUNT_POINT"
echo "API URL:     $API_URL"
echo ""

# ---- Step 1: Wait for mount ----
echo "--- Step 1: Wait for mount ---"
if bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/wait-for-mount.sh" "$MOUNT_POINT"; then
  TOTAL_PASS=$((TOTAL_PASS + 1))
else
  echo "FATAL: Mount not available. Cannot continue."
  exit 1
fi
echo ""

# ---- Step 2: FUSE file operations ----
echo "--- Step 2: FUSE file operations ---"
set +e
bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/test-fuse-operations.sh" "$MOUNT_POINT"
FUSE_FAILURES=$?
set -e

if [ "$FUSE_FAILURES" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "FUSE operations: ALL PASSED"
else
  echo "FUSE operations: $FUSE_FAILURES FAILURE(S)"
  TOTAL_FAIL=$((TOTAL_FAIL + FUSE_FAILURES))
fi
echo ""

# ---- Step 3: API round-trip ----
echo "--- Step 3: API round-trip ---"
set +e
TEST_SECRET="$TEST_SECRET" bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/test-round-trip.sh" "$MOUNT_POINT" "$API_URL"
RT_FAILURES=$?

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# wait-for-mount.sh -- Poll until the CipherBox FUSE mount point is available.
#
# Usage: ./wait-for-mount.sh [mount-point]
#   mount-point  Path to check (default: $HOME/CipherBox)
#
# Environment:
#   MOUNT_TIMEOUT  Seconds to wait before failing (default: 90)

MOUNT_POINT="${1:-$HOME/CipherBox}"
TIMEOUT="${MOUNT_TIMEOUT:-90}"
INTERVAL=2
ELAPSED=0

echo "Waiting for mount at $MOUNT_POINT (timeout: ${TIMEOUT}s)..."

while [ "$ELAPSED" -lt "$TIMEOUT" ]; do
  # Check that the mount point directory exists AND that something is mounted there.
  # macOS (FUSE-T SMB backend) shows "smbfs" in mount output; Linux shows "fuse".
  # We grep for the mount path itself for cross-platform consistency.
  if [ -d "$MOUNT_POINT" ] && mount | grep -F -q -- "$MOUNT_POINT"; then
    echo "PASS: Mount detected at $MOUNT_POINT"
    exit 0
  fi

  sleep "$INTERVAL"
  ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + INTERVAL))
done

echo "FAIL: Mount not detected after ${TIMEOUT}s"
exit 1

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes

    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})

        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'

          - platform: linux

            fuse-feature: fuse

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'

          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'

          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:

          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break

        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |

        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |

        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres

          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key

          IPFS_PROVIDER=local

          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

        with:

          path: |

            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7
