name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080

          REDIS_HOST=localhost

          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build

          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8

          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"

            fi
            sleep 1

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)

          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)

        run: |

          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \

          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init

          for i in $(seq 1 30); do

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4

---
status: fixing
trigger: "Desktop E2E tests fail on all three platforms in CI"
created: 2026-03-01T12:00:00Z
updated: 2026-03-01T13:30:00Z
---

## Current Focus

hypothesis: Four root causes across three platform failures (one shared, three platform-specific)
test: Implement all fixes and push for CI verification
expecting: All three platforms pass
next_action: Commit and push for CI run

## Symptoms

expected: All desktop E2E tests pass on macOS, Linux, and Windows in CI
actual: All three platforms fail with different errors
errors: |
  1. Windows: Kubo download fails - IOException on dist.ipfs.tech (PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest)
  2. macOS: dyld error - Library not loaded: @rpath/libfuse-t.dylib, then Abort trap: 6
  3. Linux: Mount never appears after 90s timeout
reproduction: workflow_dispatch on main (commit 232e7e8fe, CI run 22535471201)
started: CI debugging iteration

## Eliminated

- hypothesis: xvfb-action splitting commands
  evidence: Already fixed in commit dbc4e3d44, replaced with manual Xvfb
  timestamp: 2026-03-01

- hypothesis: Invoke-WebRequest for IPFS readiness check
  evidence: Already replaced with curl.exe in commit 232e7e8fe (PR #230)
  timestamp: 2026-03-01

- hypothesis: Fixes already applied on branch but not tested
  evidence: git status shows uncommitted changes to e2e-desktop.yml. The CI run 22535471201 used main (232e7e8fe) which does NOT have the frontend build or rpath fixes.
  timestamp: 2026-03-01T13:00:00Z

## Evidence

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T13:00:00Z
  checked: CI run 22535471201 headSha and headBranch
  found: headBranch=main, headSha=232e7e8fe. The CI ran from main, NOT from fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round2.
  implication: The workflow used by CI is the old version without frontend build or rpath fixes.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T13:05:00Z
  checked: git status of e2e-desktop.yml
  found: File has uncommitted changes that add frontend build step, rpath fix, and Windows Kubo bash+curl. These were NEVER committed or pushed.
  implication: ALL three fixes need to be committed and pushed for CI testing.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T13:10:00Z
  checked: CI workflow step ordering at 232e7e8fe vs current working tree
  found: Main has Node.js setup AFTER cargo build (no frontend for Tauri). Working tree moves it BEFORE.
  implication: Frontend build ordering is the shared root cause for macOS and Linux mount failures.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T13:15:00Z
  checked: FUSE-T libfuse-t.dylib location on macOS
  found: Installed at /usr/local/lib/libfuse-t.dylib. fuse-t.pc says prefix=/usr/local.
  implication: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib is correct target.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T13:20:00Z
  checked: WebKitGTK DMA-BUF renderer issues in CI
  found: WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 needed for headless CI without GPU
  implication: Linux step needs this env var to prevent WebKitGTK rendering failures.

## Resolution

root_cause: |
  FOUR ROOT CAUSES:

  1. ALL PLATFORMS (shared): Missing frontend build step. Node.js/pnpm setup was AFTER
     cargo build, so no Vite frontend existed for Tauri to embed. Without frontend assets,
     the webview loads nothing, dev-key auth never executes, mount never happens.

  2. macOS ONLY: Missing rpath for libfuse-t.dylib. FUSE-T's dylib has install name
     @rpath/libfuse-t.dylib but Rust's pkg-config crate drops the -Wl,-rpath flag.
     Binary crashes with "no LC_RPATH's found" at startup.

  3. Windows ONLY: PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest to dist.ipfs.tech gets intermittent
     IOException connection resets. Bash curl with --retry is more reliable.

  4. Linux ONLY: WebKitGTK may fail with DMA-BUF renderer in headless CI (no GPU).
     WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 forces software rendering fallback.

fix: |
  1. Move Node.js/pnpm setup BEFORE cargo build, add "Build desktop frontend" step
     that runs pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build, creates .env, and runs vite build.
  2. Add post-build install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib (idempotent with || true).
  3. Switch Windows Kubo install from PowerShell to bash shell with curl --retry.
  4. Add WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 to Linux test step env.
  5. Add diagnostic logging: redirect binary output to log file, capture on failure.

verification: Pending CI run after commit+push
files_changed:
  - .github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml

actual: All three platforms fail with different errors
errors: |
  Round 1 (run 22535471201, main branch):
    1. Windows: Kubo download fails - IOException on dist.ipfs.tech (PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest)
    2. macOS: dyld error - Library not loaded: @rpath/libfuse-t.dylib, then Abort trap: 6
    3. Linux: Mount never appears after 90s timeout

  Round 2 (run 22536010865, fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3):
    1. Windows: redis-server not found after choco install (PATH not refreshed)
    2. macOS: Binary starts OK (rpath FIXED), but mount never appears after 90s
    3. Linux: Binary starts OK, but mount never appears after 90s

    macOS+Linux show same pattern: binary starts, webview created, "setup complete", then nothing.
    No Rust logs after setup → JS never calls any Tauri IPC commands.

## Eliminated

- hypothesis: xvfb-action splitting commands
  evidence: Already fixed in commit dbc4e3d44, replaced with manual Xvfb
  timestamp: 2026-03-01

  evidence: Already replaced with curl.exe in commit 232e7e8fe (PR #230)
  timestamp: 2026-03-01

  evidence: FIXED in round 2. install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib works. CI logs show LC_RPATH present.
  timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:40:00Z

- hypothesis: Missing frontend build
  evidence: PARTIALLY FIXED. Frontend now builds before cargo build. But binary still doesn't mount.
  The frontend IS built (dist/ created), but the JS inside the webview may not execute properly.
  timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:40:00Z

- hypothesis: PowerShell Kubo download unreliable
  evidence: FIXED in round 2. Switched to bash+curl with --retry. Kubo downloaded successfully.
  timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:44:00Z

## Evidence

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:40:00Z
  checked: CI run 22536010865 macOS job
  found: |
    LC_RPATH present (/usr/local/lib) — rpath fix works.
    Binary starts: "CipherBox Desktop starting...", "dev-key provided", "System tray icon created",
    "Dev-key mode: auto-creating login webview", "CipherBox Desktop setup complete".
    Then NOTHING for 90s. No Rust log output from get_dev_key or handle_test_login_complete.
  implication: JS in webview never calls Tauri IPC. Either page doesn't load, or JS fails at module init.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:41:00Z
  checked: CI run 22536010865 Linux job
  found: Same pattern as macOS. Binary starts, webview created, setup complete, then silence.
  implication: Cross-platform issue — not platform-specific.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:44:00Z
  checked: CI run 22536010865 Windows job
  found: redis-server not found after "choco install redis-64 -y". PATH not refreshed.
  implication: Need to refresh PATH or find redis-server.exe explicitly.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:50:00Z
  checked: Frontend code analysis
  found: |
    main.ts imports from ./auth which imports @toruslabs/tss-dkls-lib (WASM-based).
    If WASM module evaluation fails, entire main.ts fails to load, init() never runs.
    No WASM files in dist/ — WASM may be inlined in JS bundle or loaded dynamically.
    Webview console output is invisible (not forwarded to stdout).
  implication: Most likely JS module evaluation failure. Need diagnostic logging.

## Fixes Applied

### Round 2 (commit 10deba393)
1. ✅ Move Node.js/pnpm setup BEFORE cargo build
2. ✅ Add "Build desktop frontend" step (crypto build + vite build with VITE env vars)
3. ✅ Add install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib for macOS
4. ✅ Switch Windows Kubo install to bash+curl with --retry
5. ✅ Add WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 for Linux
6. ✅ Add diagnostic binary log capture on failure

### Round 3 (commit 5d3ce6e26)
7. ✅ Add on_page_load callback to webview for page load logging
8. ✅ Add logging to get_dev_key Rust command
9. ✅ Set RUST_LOG=debug for verbose output
10. ✅ Add pre-flight API health check
11. ✅ Add dist/ directory listing for verification
12. ✅ Fix Windows Redis PATH refresh after choco install

## Open Questions

1. Does the webview page actually load? (on_page_load will tell us)
2. Does JS call get_dev_key? (Rust logging will tell us)
3. Does the auth module WASM import fail? (need webview console forwarding)
4. Is the API test-login endpoint reachable from the webview? (pre-flight check will tell us)

root_cause: |
  FOUR ROOT CAUSES:

  1. ALL PLATFORMS (shared): Missing frontend build step. Node.js/pnpm setup was AFTER
     cargo build, so no Vite frontend existed for Tauri to embed. Without frontend assets,
     the webview loads nothing, dev-key auth never executes, mount never happens.

  2. macOS ONLY: Missing rpath for libfuse-t.dylib. FUSE-T's dylib has install name
     @rpath/libfuse-t.dylib but Rust's pkg-config crate drops the -Wl,-rpath flag.
     Binary crashes with "no LC_RPATH's found" at startup.

  3. Windows ONLY: PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest to dist.ipfs.tech gets intermittent
     IOException connection resets. Bash curl with --retry is more reliable.

  4. Linux ONLY: WebKitGTK may fail with DMA-BUF renderer in headless CI (no GPU).
     WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 forces software rendering fallback.

fix: |
  1. Move Node.js/pnpm setup BEFORE cargo build, add "Build desktop frontend" step
     that runs pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build, creates .env, and runs vite build.
  2. Add post-build install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib (idempotent with || true).
  3. Switch Windows Kubo install from PowerShell to bash shell with curl --retry.
  4. Add WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 to Linux test step env.
  5. Add diagnostic logging: redirect binary output to log file, capture on failure.

I see the problem now. `main.ts` imports from `./auth` at the top level, which is a static import. When the module system evaluates `main.ts`, it first evaluates all its static imports, including `./auth.ts`. If `./auth.ts` fails to initialize (e.g., because of a WASM loading error in `@toruslabs/tss-dkls-lib`), then `main.ts` also fails to initialize, and `init()` is never called.

The fix is to make the auth import lazy — only import it when needed (i.e., when NOT in dev-key mode). 

In dev-key mode, we don't actually need the auth module at all, so I should trace through where auth functions are actually being called in main.ts to understand the scope of what needs to be lazily loaded.

All the auth functions are used outside the dev-key path. The `initCoreKit()` is called only after checking for dev-key mode (line 97 is after the dev-key check returns). But the problem is the static import at the top — even though the functions are only called in the non-dev-key path, the module evaluation happens unconditionally.

The fix is to use dynamic import for the auth module. Instead of statically importing from `./auth`, I'll lazy-load it only when needed.

Let me prepare this fix now. I'll use dynamic `import()` for the auth module, which means when in dev-key mode, it won't even try to load the auth module (with its WASM dependencies).

There it is! The critical diagnostic:

```
Webview page load: url=http://localhost:1420/, event=Started
Webview page load: url=http://localhost:1420/, event=Finished
```

The webview is loading from `http://localhost:1420/` — **NOT** from the embedded frontend. This is the Tauri dev URL, not the `frontendDist`. In a debug build (`cargo build` without release flag), Tauri uses `devUrl` instead of embedding the frontend. There's no Vite dev server running on port 1420 in CI, so the page loads an empty/error page and the JS never executes.

The fix is either:
1. Start a Vite dev server before the binary, OR
2. Build with `--release` so Tauri embeds the frontend, OR
3. Set the `TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE` or use `cargo tauri build` instead

Let me check which approach is simplest.

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          # Refresh PATH to include chocolatey-installed binaries
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "User") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $redisServer = Get-Command redis-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if (-not $redisServer) {
            # Fallback: search common install locations
            $found = Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\ProgramData\chocolatey" -Recurse -Filter "redis-server.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($found) {
              $env:PATH = "$($found.DirectoryName);$env:PATH"
            } else {
              throw "redis-server.exe not found after installation"
            }
          }
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=debug
          # Verify API is reachable before starting desktop
          echo "Pre-flight: checking API health..."
          curl -sf http://localhost:3000/health && echo " OK" || echo " FAILED"
          echo "Pre-flight: checking test-login endpoint..."
          curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:3000/auth/test-login \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -d '{"email":"preflight@test.local","secret":"e2e-test-secret-ci-only"}' \
            && echo " OK" || echo " FAILED (expected if endpoint requires specific format)"
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          # Verify rpath was set
          otool -l "$BINARY" | grep -A2 LC_RPATH || echo "WARNING: No LC_RPATH found"
          # Verify frontend assets are embedded
          ls -la apps/desktop/dist/ || echo "WARNING: dist directory missing"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: debug
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          # Verify FUSE is available
          ls -la /dev/fuse || echo "WARNING: /dev/fuse not found"
          # Verify API is reachable
          echo "Pre-flight: checking API health..."
          curl -sf http://localhost:3000/health && echo " OK" || echo " FAILED"
          # Verify frontend assets exist
          ls -la apps/desktop/dist/ || echo "WARNING: dist directory missing"
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          # Refresh PATH to include chocolatey-installed binaries
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "User") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $redisServer = Get-Command redis-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if (-not $redisServer) {
            # Fallback: search common install locations
            $found = Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\ProgramData\chocolatey" -Recurse -Filter "redis-server.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($found) {
              $env:PATH = "$($found.DirectoryName);$env:PATH"
            } else {
              throw "redis-server.exe not found after installation"
            }
          }
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: debug
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          # Verify FUSE is available
          ls -la /dev/fuse || echo "WARNING: /dev/fuse not found"
          # Verify API is reachable
          echo "Pre-flight: checking API health..."
          curl -sf http://localhost:3000/health && echo " OK" || echo " FAILED"
          # Verify frontend assets exist
          ls -la apps/desktop/dist/ || echo "WARNING: dist directory missing"
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7
